answer.rationale: Avoid promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment produced short-term signup and qualified-revenue gains but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, making it unsuitable for the primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue. Deploy targeted in-product activation messaging to price-sensitive SMB accounts to reinforce realized value and meaningful product use; prior evidence supports improved early engagement, but its effect on current churn risk remains uncertain, so measure retention and qualified revenue before broad rollout.
